title: Discovering the inhibition of YAP/TEAD Hippo signaling pathway via new pyrazolone derivatives: synthesis, molecular docking and biological investigations.
authors: Noser, Ahmed A; Salem, Maha M; Baren, Mohamed H; Selim, Adel I; ElSafty, Esraa M
one_liner_zh: 该文合成吡唑啉酮衍生物并通过分子对接研究其对YAP/TEAD蛋白的抑制，虽涉及蛋白-DNA互作相关通路但核心是药物小分子-蛋白结合，非TF-DNA互作体系，方法仅常规对接，与本课题关联较弱。
abstract: Heterocyclic compounds play a crucial role in the drug discovery process and development due to their significant presence and importance. Here, we report a comprehensive analysis of new pyrazolone derivatives, prepared according to a clear-cut, uncomplicated procedure. The pyrazolone derivatives were thoroughly characterized using various methods, such as elemental analysis, NMR, and FT-IR. The molecular docking interactions between the new pyrazolone derivatives and YAP/TEAD target protein observed that compound 4 had the top-ranked binding energy towards YAP/TEAD with a value equal to - 9.670 kcal/mol and this theoretically proves its inhibitory efficacy against YAP/TEAD Hippo signaling pathway. Besides, compound 4 showed the best IC(50) against HCT-116, HepG-2, and MCF-7 (in-vitro) with IC(50) 7.67 +/- 0.5, 5.85 +/- 0.4, and 6.97 +/- 0.5 muM, respectively which confirmed our results towards suppressing YAP/TEAD protein (in-silico) compared with the IC(50) of Sorafenib (SOR) reference chemotherapeutic drug 5.47 +/- 0.3, 9.18 +/- 0.6 and 7.26 +/- 0.3 muM, respectively. Also, compound 4 showed no cytotoxic effects against human lung fibroblast normal cell line (WI-38) and its pharmacokinetics were elucidated theoretically using ADMET compared with SOR which observed highly toxic effects on normal cells with IC(50) equal to 20.27 +/- 0.45 muM. Additionally, compound 4 clarified a powerful antioxidant scavenging activity against DPPH free radicals (in-vitro). Conclusively, newly synthesized pyrazolone derivative 4 could be used as anticancer candidate via inhibiting the YAP/TEAD mediated Hippo signaling pathway.
abstract_zh: 杂环化合物在药物发现和开发过程中因其显著的存在和重要性而发挥着关键作用。在此，我们报告了对新型吡唑啉酮衍生物的综合分析，这些衍生物通过一种清晰、简便的程序制备。吡唑啉酮衍生物通过多种方法进行了充分表征，如元素分析、NMR和FT-IR。新型吡唑啉酮衍生物与YAP/TEAD靶蛋白之间的分子对接相互作用表明，化合物4对YAP/TEAD具有最高排名结合能，其值等于-9.670 kcal/mol，这从理论上证明了其对YAP/TEAD Hippo信号通路的抑制效力。此外，化合物4对HCT-116、HepG-2和MCF-7（体外）显示出最佳IC(50)，其IC(50)分别为7.67 ± 0.5、5.85 ± 0.4和6.97 ± 0.5 μM，这证实了我们关于抑制YAP/TEAD蛋白（计算机模拟）的结果，与参考化疗药物索拉非尼（SOR）的IC(50)（分别为5.47 ± 0.3、9.18 ± 0.6和7.26 ± 0.3 μM）相比。此外，化合物4对人肺成纤维细胞正常细胞系（WI-38）无细胞毒性作用，其药代动力学通过ADMET理论阐明，与SOR相比，SOR对正常细胞表现出高毒性效应，其IC(50)等于20.27 ± 0.45 μM。另外，化合物4对DPPH自由基（体外）显示出强大的抗氧化清除活性。总之，新合成的吡唑啉酮衍生物4可通过抑制YAP/TEAD介导的Hippo信号通路，作为抗癌候选药物使用。
